mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile: the result showed how oxygen reaches tissues and how blood returns.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the breathing muscles felt predictable; the paired chest outlines were clear, but the result added little beyond the part descriptions.

surprise.text: The exchange surface made the two directions of gas movement clear while emphasizing that air and blood remain separate.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although several steps offered only one combination, so I was following the available path rather than working out compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the lung and blood systems join to serve working cells made me curious how the remaining body systems will connect, though the largely predictable choices limited the gameplay challenge.
